verdict.rationale: Unity's Package Manager entries show semantic versioning (e.g., com.unity.ai.assistant 2.20, com.unity.ai.inference 2.4) and there is a concrete, documented instance of API deprecation — the in-editor MCP server is explicitly marked deprecated in favor of the new CLI's MCP mode, with clear migration guidance. However, there is no evidence of a general, formal deprecation policy document covering Unity's scripting/public APIs or Editor version lifecycle. Missing for 10: an explicit published deprecation policy/versioning guarantee for the core public APIs, LTS/version support timelines, and independent confirmation that agents can rely on API stability across releases.
